attendance_policy: 100% attendance is the expected norm, under no circumstances should a student’s attendance fall below 60% in this course. A student falling short of this minimum attendance requirement shall not be permitted to appear in the comprehensive examination and will be considered as not having cleared the course.
makeup_policy: Make-up will be granted only on genuine reasons. However, prior permission is must. For medical cases, a certificate from the concerned physician of the Medical Centre must be produced.
